environment.description: Flask migration service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 8080. Network ACLs allow inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. The service is accessible via public DNS at migrate.example.com.

config.tls: ACM certificate on ALB, passthrough to HTTP on container
